🔥 The fire settles. Felipe has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Nevermore — I put it down today." "Its shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides across the ground toward you — a straight black lane, growing. The bird hasn't moved. The shadow has." "It climbs, laughing in a dead voice — out of spear reach, watching." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Chloe breathes "Tell me you didn't go alone." Aroha says "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🕯️ Erin Singh is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
What Erin kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
The village's quarrel was with Erin — and Erin is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
At the grave, Marvin, Felipe, Aditya and 3 more speak for Wei — "Erin trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.

tableLines.line: The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. A man, maybe 30s speaks at Stonebridge's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
🎁 "OH! You can hold more now! We've been HOLDING this — take it, take it, take it!" (The System's gift awaits — choose an ability.)
🔇 The birds have gone quiet. Even the crickets. The woods are holding their breath.
It is holding a meeting. About you.
"WALKOUT! WALKOUT!" It climbs onto the bullhorn and stops fighting entirely — full-time coordination. (Allies +8 damage. The rep is UNTARGETABLE while coordinating.)
"The line — the LINE is broken!" The bullhorn wavers. Nobody is chanting anymore. It climbs down, pencil out. (The walkout collapsed — it is TARGETABLE again. End it.)
"PICKET LINE!" A Rut King lumbers in, holding a tiny sign. (The rep called backup — from the OLD wave.)
"Brothers, sisters, monsters — gather round." It is holding a meeting. About you.
💔 A faction of Emberhold has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Ines.
📓 Codex: Emberhold split (cannibal). The Red Table formed; 2 petition at Haven's fire.
💔 A faction of Ashford has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table II is a new fire in the world now — 3 people under Theo.

FUSION REACTOR: the pellet goes in — properly, inside you. A warm hum starts behind your ribs and settles. You will never be hungry again. One reactor per world: yours. It does not come out. (The System is DELIGHTED. That should worry you.)

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and with it the joy: food gives you no morale, feasts give you no comfort, and your fire never burns hotter than this. A cold spot at every table.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
🧳 Ashford has split — the eaters walked. They call the new fire The Red Table II. Half of them were headed this way, or so the traveler says.

The little star inside Erin goes quiet — and wakes up inside Chloe. Erin never got hungry while the village did, so the pellet moved to hungrier hands: Chloe will never be hungry again while it hums, and Erin is hungry again, for the first time in a long while. The table can hear a feast again.
With Haven grieving, Stonebridge installs their own speaker at the table. Tribute rises to 7,500 kcal/week. Grief is leverage, and they know it. The link holds — it was never with one person.
